{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean customer_age: replace -1 with NaN
sales['customer_age_clean'] = sales['customer_age'].where(sales['customer_age'] != -1, other=pd.NA)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age_clean'].mean()

# Print the result to ensure it's from actual computation
print(mean_age_converted)"}
